title: Encoding jumps
description:
Write the bytes of a jump or call from one address to another.

```
jmp from 0x1000 to 0x1050  -> EB 4E          (short, 2 bytes)
jmp from 0x1000 to 0x2000  -> E9 FB 0F 00 00 (near, 5 bytes)
call from 0x1000 to 0x0800 -> E8 FB F7 FF FF
too far for rel32 -> refused
```
requirements: Use the 2-byte `EB` form when it fits in a signed byte, otherwise `E9` with 4 bytes, little-endian.
Refuse targets more than ±2 GB away.
stretch: Encode `jne` (`75 xx` short, `0F 85 xx xx xx xx` near).
